title: Synthesis, structural insights and bio-evaluation of N-phenoxyethylisatin hydrazones as potent α-glucosidase inhibitors
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,14717-14729
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00770D, Paper
Open Access

Saba Mehreen, Muhammad Imran Ali, Sidra tul Muntha, Mehwash Zia, Aman Ullah, Saeed Ullah, Ajmal Khan, Javid Hussain, Muhammad U. Anwar, Ahmed Al-Harrasi, Muhammad Moazzam Naseer
A series of N-phenoxyethylisatin hydrazones 1(a–l) have been synthesized and structurally characterized, showing promising α-glucosidase inhibitory activity, with IC50 values ranging from 3.64 ± 0.13 to 94.89 ± 0.64 μM.
